description: This PHP source file defines an ExceptionSubscriber class that implements event handling for exceptions within a Symfony-based web application. It subscribes to kernel exception events and constructs appropriate HTTP responses based on the exception type.

classes.name: ExceptionSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class for handling exceptions during Symfony kernel events, setting appropriate HTTP responses based on the type of exception.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping kernel exception events to handler methods, subscribing 'onExceptionEvent' with a priority of 500.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles exception events by determining the type of exception, setting response status codes, and preparing the HTTP response accordingly.
